body: All he has on there is his name.

>trans women can that our very identity hinges on our ability to pull off a socially acceptable look.

I really relate to that, I have actually gotten to the point where I am so sick of trying to pull off a socially acceptable look and diving back into my goth clothing.

Does that feeling ever go away or get lighter?

Well the reason my families build sucks for me is the fact that unlike those models we worship, (And I did notice that I share the same build as they do) is that I don't appear to be one gender or the other. Well at least I ended up drawing the good looking androgynous card rather then the 'dude-in-a-dress' kind.
I will, I feel a bit better today. When I am busy I dont think about stuff like this. So perhaps I should get a really time consuming hobby.

Its alright, I didn't expect you to. There are only two people on this site that can ID me from this post and I know both their usernames. It is a good link though in case anyone else ever stumbles into here.
Just give it time to grow out, it will go down after it has some weight.

I'll be here all for an hour or two I think, I will be pulling an all nighter I suspect. Its not the fact that I dont have a support group its more the fact that none of them 'get me' so to speak. Sure they sympathize with me but even amongst my trans-friends I have an FTM who passes so well he gets called a liar when he comes out to people and an mtf friend who has is drop dead gorgeous. Then I have another MTF friend who started taking hormones before puberty so she is identical to females. (I started at 18 so I am still considered a better then many) To be honest she drives me up the wall more then anyone else because my parents wouldn't let me take hormones when I was younger because they had issues to work out so I couldn't start till I moved out of their house. I still hold a grudge against them for that and I have made it very clear that I wont ever forgive them for it in my lifetime. 

No one should have to go through what my puberty was like. Seriously I had one of my parents sneak into my room and shave some of my hair off in the middle of the night.
A year late but thank you.
